entries.11cdb947710f9c3d: Sota System Co., Ltd. is involved in developing the ETC system, which is widely used mainly on expressways across Japan.
entries.2af7358eb0fc4820: This business is handled by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Ōbarutekku Co., Ltd., and involves the development, manufacture and sale of fare collection equipment such as fare boxes for route buses, as well as product maintenance services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is ¥7,025 million.
entries.37169209893b24e9: This category covers fare boxes, fare box safes and fare box software, which are the company's main products. Fare boxes include instant-counting fare boxes, which calculate the fare from the barcode on a ticket or the ride information on a card, instantly count the fare deposited and settle it automatically, and general-purpose fare boxes, in which crew members visually check the fare. This also includes fare boxes for one-man railway operation and gate-type fare boxes.
entries.515c5c1d562f7432: This category covers ticket issuing machines, LCD fare displays and voice synthesis devices in the on-board equipment field, as well as fare settlement equipment, data management servers and commuter pass issuing systems in the ground equipment field. In addition to bus equipment, it also makes departure indicators for railways and display guidance devices for airports.
entries.5b5cde7f4856a8cf: Azuma Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures systems that turn vehicles into IoT devices, collecting data from GPS and various other sensors and communicating via wireless connection to the internet.
entries.62adc9bec53dc072: Aftersales service is the category that sells consumable and maintenance parts used for inspection and servicing of products, and performs repairs inside and outside the warranty period, overhauls, and on-site periodic inspections under maintenance contracts.
entries.67be298614ef1fb0: Road Traffic Information and Communication System
entries.81729bc0d8f35265: Azuma Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures systems that process data from inspection cameras and other equipment on high-speed signal processing boards, automating the pass/fail judgment of the appearance of inspected objects.
entries.a1c97e458500fac7: This category covers card devices and card device software that support fare settlement using contactless IC cards and similar media. It offers the multi-payment terminal “BOSS,” which supports various payment methods such as IC cards, QR codes and credit card touch payment, and the cashless fare collection-compatible tablet terminal “SELF,” which can be introduced as a standalone terminal.
entries.a255ae2dc65c9b1f: This is the business carried out by the consolidated subsidiaries Sota System Co., Ltd. and Azuma Co., Ltd., which develops systems for transport infrastructure projects, ETC-related development projects and social infrastructure projects, and provides engineering and software design, as well as the development of embedded systems for IoT and M2M. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥647 million.
entries.c743be8aa9e60f74: It is involved in developing the system (VICS) that collects real-time traffic information, such as congestion information and road closures, from traffic volumes measured by traffic measurement systems, and delivers it to car navigation systems.
entries.e428e1b3f26df210: A manufacturer that develops, manufactures and sells fare collection equipment, such as fare boxes for route buses and cashless payment terminals.
